methods.timing: Local fresh compiler process and project session through complete Wasm, warm filesystem, production compiler, eight workers, 9.5 s session cap. Unprofiled measurements are ordered by round in each array. First wave cycles through all six permutations; later pairs alternate which layout runs first. Workloads elsewhere on the host varied between waves; compare only inside a wave.
methods.uncertainty: Paired saving is original minus candidate in the same round. The interval resamples paired differences 10000 times with seed 65361, giving a descriptive 95% percentile interval for their median.
methods.queue: Additional builds with release-native queue probes, separate from fresh timings. Check and interface-publication thread CPU are the two components of each node weight. All dependency edges checked against loader traversal, packet-tail sums against aggregate worker CPU. Longest chain is a model using median weights. Separately timestamped claim, first interface publication and finish for every node, and checked consumer claim follows publication of each import. A negative consumer offset means that body started before robots published. Each observed completion chain follows the last-publishing prerequisite of the last-finishing job.

retained.method: Change the reachable exported hauler_turn constant from 8.0 to 7.25 in robots or robot_motion respectively.
